This '''battle''', described as great, was led by [[Kazdan Paratus]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Employed using [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] of Paratus's own creation, it was Kazdan's last battle before he returned to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|temple]] to focus on building and fixing various mechanical errata.<ref name="TFU">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]''</ref>
